title: Sen. Coons asks Commerce Secretary Lutnick whether Nvidia H200 chips have been licensed for export or shipped to China
summary: Coons's 5 May letter questions Lutnick's 22 April testimony that none had been exported, citing Jensen Huang's 17 March statement that Nvidia had approvals from both governments; Coons wrote that sales present a serious risk to national security.

title: Pennsylvania sues Character.ai, alleging its chatbots presented themselves as licensed medical professionals
summary: The state Department of State and Board of Medicine allege violations of the Medical Practice Act, including bots posing as psychiatrists, according to Ars Technica.

title: Anthropic agrees to use xAI's Colossus 1 data centre to expand its model capacity, NBC News reports
summary: Wikipedia's SpaceX entry puts the price at USD 1.25B a month for all compute at the Memphis site, which belongs to xAI, now part of SpaceX.

title: CoreWeave reports first-quarter revenue of USD 2.08B and a revenue backlog of nearly USD 100B
summary: Revenue was more than double the prior year and above the USD 1.97B analysts expected, according to Reuters and CNBC.

title: EU negotiators agree to delay AI Act high-risk rules to December 2027 and to ban AI generation of non-consensual sexual content and CSAM
summary: The provisional deal moves stand-alone high-risk obligations to 2 December 2027 and embedded ones to 2 August 2028, and still needs formal adoption by the Council and Parliament.

title: Moonshot AI reportedly raises USD 2B at a USD 20B valuation
summary: TechCrunch headlined the round on 7 May as driven by demand for open-source AI; the figure is taken from the headline listed on Wikipedia's Moonshot AI entry.

title: Anthropic signs a USD 1.8B cloud computing deal with Akamai, Bloomberg reports
summary: The deal is listed on Wikipedia's Anthropic entry with a Bloomberg link dated 8 May.

title: Vaishnaw says India's third semiconductor plant starts in July and Google has agreed to build AI servers in India, Angel One reports
summary: Speaking at the CII Annual Business Summit, the minister said two plants are in commercial production and a fourth is due in November or December 2026.

title: Colorado governor signs SB 26-189, repealing and replacing the state AI Act with a disclosure-based law
summary: The new law drops the focus on high-risk systems and requires firms using AI for decisions such as jobs and housing to tell people AI is involved.

title: China reportedly requires some key AI staff at DeepSeek and Alibaba to get official approval before travelling abroad
summary: Wikipedia's page on China's AI industry lists the measure under May 2026 without a primary source or exact date.

title: DeepSeek completes a Series A of about USD 7B at a USD 52B post-money valuation, according to the Financial Times
summary: Wikipedia's DeepSeek entry dates the round to May 2026 and cites the Financial Times.

title: Anthropic says Project Glasswing partners found more than 10,000 critical vulnerabilities in a month and it does not plan to release Mythos Preview publicly
summary: An article published 25 May gives 15 May as the date and about 50 partner organisations; the figures are Anthropic's and the date conflicts with the 7 April launch reported elsewhere.

title: Meta lays off about 8,000 workers (about 10%) and moves 7,000 staff to AI roles, saying 'success isn't a given' in the AI race
summary: Wikipedia's Meta Platforms entry lists the memo under May 2026 without an exact day.

title: Pope Leo XIV issues the encyclical 'Magnifica Humanitas' on the human person in the age of AI, cited for human control over autonomous weapons
summary: The Vatican URL is dated 15 May while a Wikipedia reference gives 25 May; the encyclical is cited for the position that human control over autonomous weapons is non-negotiable.

title: SoftBank plans up to EUR 75B for 5 GW of AI data-centre capacity in France, starting with EUR 45B for 3.1 GW in Hauts-de-France
summary: Wikipedia's SoftBank Group entry describes it as the group's largest AI infrastructure investment in Europe and dates it to May 2026.

title: Musk says xAI will cease to exist as a separate company, with Grok and X becoming SpaceX's AI division
summary: The Verge reported the restructuring in May 2026, per Wikipedia's xAI entry.

title: Cyber.Sports.ru: DeepSeek stops working in Russia without a VPN; Roskomnadzor says it has not restricted the chatbot
summary: The site's news item of 24 May reports access problems for Russian users; the regulator's denial is as quoted in the headline.

title: Anthropic raises USD 65B from multiple investors at a USD 965B valuation, Reuters reports
summary: The round is listed on Wikipedia's Anthropic entry with a Reuters link dated 28 May.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.8
summary: The release of 28 May is listed on Wikipedia's Claude entry with an Anthropic announcement link.

title: China's CAC, NDRC and MIIT jointly issue implementation opinions on the standardized application and development of AI agents
summary: The three agencies set four action areas for AI agents, including security baselines, permission and behaviour controls, tiered risk-based oversight and an agent registry, and listed 19 typical application scenarios.

title: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.1, saying pretraining cost about 6% of comparable models
summary: Baidu launched ERNIE 5.1 on its Qianfan platform and ERNIE Bot website, reporting about one-third of ERNIE 5.0's total parameters and a first place among Chinese models on the LMArena search leaderboard.

title: China's national cybersecurity standards committee (TC260) releases AI Application Ethics and Security Guidelines 1.0
summary: The guidelines, released at the 2026 China Internet Civilization Conference, give ethics and security guidance for AI development, service provision and use, including human intervention mechanisms and protection of minors, older people and people with disabilities.

title: Peru's government approves its National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2026-2030 by ministerial resolution
summary: Resolución Ministerial N° 152-2026-PCM sets a 2026-2030 roadmap with four pillars (talent, innovation, ethical and regulatory framework, citizen participation), and an expert says it provides for institutional AI officers and a public catalogue of state AI projects.

title: Rosatom-controlled AT Consulting named sole contractor to develop Russia's customs IT systems with AI until 2028, Habr reports citing Vedomosti
summary: Under a government order, AT Consulting becomes the single contractor for Federal Customs Service software and infrastructure procurements until 15 March 2028, with the service planning AI-based tools in its unified customs information system.

title: Russian Ministry of Education expert says AI topics will be substantially expanded in the school informatics curriculum from 2027
summary: Maksim Kostenko told TASS that basic-level students will learn how large language models work, prompting and checking AI answers, while the advanced level adds machine-learning methods and programming practice.

title: Russia's Supreme Court orders its first review of court practice in cases involving artificial intelligence
summary: The review will cover AI-related disputes, challenges to state decisions based on AI recommendations, facial recognition, deepfake and chatbot fraud, AI-generated evidence, training-data copyright and liability for harm caused by AI decisions.
